content:
**Monongah Power Substation MZ-01** is a location in the Savage Divide region of Appalachia. 

One of three substations once connected to the Monongah Power Plant, providing power to Sunnytop Ski Lanes.

Found on the intersection of state routes 95 and 98, near Sunnytop Station. This small enclosure contains many Scorched and some minor loot in the maintenance shack.

Monongah Power Substation MZ-01 appears in *Fallout 76*.
